name: 44667-prefillheavy-qwen3moe30b-1gpu
model: nvidia/Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4 -- public and ungated, ~15 GB of NVFP4 weights on disk.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM sparse MoE decoder, per the checkpoint's own config.json: 48 layers, 128 experts with 8 active per token, 32 query heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, NVFP4 W4A4 weights and an fp8 KV cache scheme.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1 -- one request in flight at a time -- bounded at 55 requests with a 9.39% warmup -> 5 warmup and 50 measured, no cooldown. `safety_seconds: 5400` is a runaway guard, not a target.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 2000 prompt tokens and exactly 100 output tokens (min = max on both, no variance), greedy at temperature 0.0, prompts drawn independently with prefix caching off, seed 44667. The backend renders each row as a chat message and applies the template, so the engine's own prompt-token count reads a handful above 2000.
purpose: A single-user document analysis assistant on one GPU, handling 2000-token prompts with short answers, one at a time.
launch:
model: nvidia/Qwen3-30B-A3B-NVFP4

# Both emulation pins are required. Left at `auto`, this engine selects a native NVFP4 kernel for
# that half on an H100 -- silently, with no error -- and the run still produces a number.
moe-backend: emulation
linear-backend: emulation

tensor-parallel-size: 1
enforce-eager: true

# Pinned, not decoration: the in-process backend would otherwise resolve max-num-batched-tokens to
# 16384 and chunk every 2000-token prompt differently.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-chunked-prefill: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096

# Sized to this workload rather than left at the engine default of 0.90. Deepest possible KV
# residency is 1 stream x ~2110 tokens, and fp8 KV at 2 x 48 x 4 x 128 x 1 B = 48 KiB/token makes
# that under 0.1 GiB. 0.55 of an 80 GB card is 43.6 GiB; ~18 GiB of weights and peak activation
# leaves ~26 GiB of pool, orders of magnitude more than the workload can occupy, so nothing is ever
# preempted. 0.90 demands 71.3 GiB free at construction and the engine refuses to start if anything
# else is resident on the card.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.55
